UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
ALEXANDRIA DIVISION
MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,
Plaintiff,
V.
Case No. 1:26-cv-02331-RDA-IDD
The Honorable Judge
Rossie D. Alston Jr.
KATIE HALL, individually;
NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN;
META PLATFORMS, INC.;
and JOHN/JANE DOES 1-6,
Defendants.
NOTICE OF HEARING
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine will bring his Motion for
Leave to File Supplemental Complaint Pursuant to Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 15(d) for
hearing before the Honorable Rossie D. Alston, Jr. on Friday, September 25, 2026, at the time
designated for the Court's civil motions docket, or at such other time as the Court may direct.
Plaintiff and counsel for Defendant National Center for Missing & Exploited Children
conferred by telephone on August 20, 2026 regarding hearing availability. During that conference,
Plaintiff advised counsel that his then-existing availability was limited to September 18, 2026.
Following the conference, Plaintiff was able to make arrangements permitting his availability on
September 25, 2026.
NCMEC has separately noticed its pending Motion to Dismiss for hearing on September
25, 2026. Plaintiff therefore notices the Rule 15(d) motion for hearing on that same date.

Date: August 20, 2026
Respectfully submitted,
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
1520 Belle View Blvd, Ste. #5847
Alexandria, Virginia 22307
(407) 794-6503
jayballentine@protonmail.com

CERTIFICATION PURSUANT TO LOCAL CIVIL RULE 83.1(N)
Pursuant to Local Civil Rule 83.1(N), I declare under penalty of perjury that no attorney has
prepared, or assisted in the preparation of, the foregoing Notice of Hearing.
Name of Pro Se Litigant: Marvelle J. Ballentine
Signature of Pro Se Litigant
Executed on: August 20, 2026

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE
I certify that on August 20, 2026, I submitted the foregoing Notice of Hearing, which
contains the certification required by Local Civil Rule 83.1(N), to the Clerk of Court through the
Court's Electronic Document Submission System for docketing on CM/ECF. Upon docketing,
counsel for Defendant National Center for Missing & Exploited Children will receive notice
through the Court's CM/ECF system. Pursuant to Federal Rules of Civil Procedure 5(a)(1) and 5(b)
(2)(C), I served a true and correct copy of the foregoing by first-class mail, postage prepaid,
addressed as follows: Katie Hall, c/o National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, 333 John
Carlyle Street, Suite 125, Alexandria, Virginia 22314; and Meta Platforms, Inc., c/o CSC -
Lawyers Incorporating Service, 2710 Gateway Oaks Drive, Suite 150N, Sacramento, California
95833.
Marvelle J. Ballentine
